notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
Hello!

After the feedback about translation issues, I made a review with my teacher and today I've released a new English version. Besides that, I moved the wood close to the stream (Kimchi Tea and Miraakles feedback - Thank you guys!). All versions are updated. 

If you have more suggestions, please, feel free to help me. 

Kisses
Victoria
